results.title: Luck My Life
results.overview: Born with a silver spoon, an arrogant mahjong player loses all his luck. Now, he has to re-learn the game and will soon discover the joy and principles of life over the mahjong table. The final match will be his one shot to turn his life around.

results.title: Sweetgrass
results.overview: SWEETGRASS follows Isabelle and her daughter Mariya for over seven years, as childhood gradually gives way to adolescence. Between daily life, the land, and powwows, the film accompanies a living transmission: that of a language, gestures, and a way of inhabiting the world, carried by a lineage of women where kokom remains ever-present. Without attempting to explain, SWEETGRASS observes what circulates between them, transforms, and takes root over time.

results.title: Bledders
results.overview: When criminal friends Kadir and Yilmaz go undercover at an elite private school, they find themselves immersed in a world of privilege, strict rules, and hidden diamonds. What begins as a simple cover quickly turns into an explosive clash between two worlds — and a true test of their friendship.

results.title: Vivaah
results.overview: Vivaah revolves around four married couples as they navigate the chaotic challenges of modern relationships. From unexpected restrictions and arranged marriages to a wife's romantic longings amid a workaholic husband's neglect, the narrative follows four women fighting unique emotional battles in search of fulfilment and understanding.

results.title: The Boy Who Counted Cars
results.overview: A young man convinced that his world is virtual falls for a mysterious woman, only to wonder whether she is his perfect love or an NPC in the simulation.

results.title: Skate to Hell
results.overview: A group of teenagers steal a supernatural skateboard owned by Satan's son. Now the devil wants it back.

results.title: The man who can't sleep
results.original_title: De man die niet slapen kan
results.overview: Kept awake by an unbearably loud punk concert, a man's frustration mounts as his deaf girlfriend struggles to understand why he’s making such a fuss.

results.title: The End
results.overview: Who is the world-famous artist Albert Oehlen, and why does he change bodies? A punk-rooted, Surrealism-infused brew of documentary and fiction, the magical with the banal, the outrageous with the subdued, and the sublime with the crass.

results.title: La Marca del Jaguar: El despertar del fuego
results.original_title: La Marca del Jaguar: El despertar del fuego

results.title: J.
results.overview: David keeps seeing his ex in other people's faces.

results.title: 0187 UFO
results.overview: There is a city in Italy on the coast surrounded by the mountains called La Spezia with an area code of 0187, which has been the scene of numerous UFO sightings. The peak of sightings dates back to the 70s: the reports include strange lights in the sky, disappearances and unknown presences in the woods. In the present day, four young people arrive looking for answers, they venture into the places that were the scene of these disturbing events.

results.title: Un Cordero de 100 Kilos
results.overview: Through the testimonies of those who knew Los Redondos firsthand and a personal search, a documentary explores how a band becomes a shared identity, following the traces of a flame that no one can fully define.

results.title: Try Again
results.overview: A wildly funny family comedy about a guy who sells his soul for six wishes so he can reach the one he truly loves.

results.title: Insecta
results.overview: A celebrated horror novelist returns to an isolated estate to say goodbye to her dying father, only to discover that the monstrous imaginary insect that tormented her childhood may have been real all along.

results.title: Turnê Três Graças
results.overview: An immersive experience inside the universe of TV Globo's soap opera. Belo and Xamã lead the show with guests like Sophie Charlotte, Alana Cabral and Péricles, among others.

results.title: Cause & Effect
results.overview: One simple act of littering sets off a karmic chain reaction for citygoers on a lazy weekend afternoon.

results.title: Nang Matakasan ang Tagay
results.overview: On the eve of his departure, a father finds himself caught between the tender truth of who his son is and the harsh expectations of the macho world around him.
